architecture_clues: Hika Delle Donne, Lead Product Manager of AI R&D at the NBA, says, “The NBA is constantly exploring new ways to elevate the fan experience, and we knew we could make better use of the immense amount of data we have to give fans even more of what they want—real-time insights into gameplay.”
To offer a smarter way to watch the game, the NBA is using Microsoft Azure OpenAI Service to power “NBA Insights,” an AI-driven feature embedded within the NBA App.
At the heart of NBA Insights is Azure OpenAI, processing immense amounts of data quickly.
The technology allows us to analyze player performance, game strategy, and team dynamics to get fans more involved,” says Sydney Sarachek, AI Technical Lead at the NBA.
“We’re taking the experience even further by integrating historical context and real-time sources.
Providing a comprehensive view, grounded in existing and emerging data, helps us serve up meaningful information to fans following the action in the NBA App.”
